request_rows.response_preview: {"type":"bash","command":"cat CacheDeleteMessage.java","timeout_sec":10,"purpose":"Read the source file"}
{"type": "bash", "command": "cat verify.py", "timeout_sec": 10, "purpose": "Read the verification script"}
{"type": "bash", "command": "python3 verify.py", "timeout_sec": 30, "purpose": "Run verification with python3"}

{"type": "final", "answer": "Fixed the boundary error in `incrementRetry()`. The original code incremented `retryCount` before reading the delay, causing the first retry to use index 1 (5s) instead of index 0 (1s), and the last retry to skip updating `nextExecuteTime` because `getNextDelaySeconds()` returned -1 after the increment. The fix reads the delay first, updates `nextExecuteTime`, then increments `retryCount`."}
